training_split: Exactly the frozen Q1/V3-R1 split; assertions before execution
scope: Conditional known family, three active destinations and supplied partition; previously assessed development inputs, not independent confirmation
initial_stage: Read frozen Q1 estimate and V3-R1 mean-only coefficients/score-response; no rerun of either stage
update: Apply the entire saved local unit-box score-response once, without clipping, damping, line search, re-estimation of the step or truth selection
linear_profile: At updated kinetics, evaluate the frozen mean-plus-Gram corrected risk once (three linear solves)
risk_domain: A Gram failure or box violation fails that update; no stabilized alternative or fallback is selected
reason_for_one_step: Corrected quadratic risk with unconstrained linear coefficients can be unbounded outside its positive-Gram region. A single declared local update does not assert a globally defined minimization problem or convergence.
heldout: Raw V1 weak forward prediction using frozen updated parameters and coefficients; no coefficient refit and no heldout noise calibration in fitting
control: Reuse the 18 saved V3-R1 mean-only conditional coefficient profiles at unchanged Q1 internal parameters. These are not new independent fits.
scoring: Only after all updated estimates/controls are sealed. Reuse V1 grades without rescoring historical models; grade new decompositions with original 12/18/18/25 percent parameter gates.
stopping: One update per fixed input. Preserve all failures; do not repeat the step, adjust the radius, extend blocks or start an independent confirmation on failure.
